title: Simulated Rooftop Unit Service Manual
content: For this demonstration unit, fault F07 indicates that the airflow-proving input was not confirmed during the startup sequence. A displayed code is a clue, not a diagnosis; confirm the complete model and the code against the unit label and full manual.
checks: Confirm the complete model number and displayed fault code from the equipment label/display; record them before proceeding.
Review the approved maintenance record for recent filter or airflow-related service.
From a safe external position, check whether the return-air grille is visibly obstructed. Do not remove equipment panels or reach into the unit.

title: Simulated Site Service Procedure
content: If a startup fault repeats after the documented external checks, stop troubleshooting and escalate to a qualified HVAC supervisor. Do not bypass an interlock, defeat a sensor, open energized panels, or perform electrical tests unless specifically authorized, trained, and following the applicable site procedure.
checks: If the fault repeats after approved external checks, stop and contact the qualified HVAC supervisor; include the displayed code and checks already completed.

title: Simulated Preventive Maintenance Guide
content: A recent filter replacement or airflow service may provide useful context for a later airflow-proving fault. Service history is contextual evidence only and does not establish the fault's cause.
checks: Review recent maintenance entries for filter replacement or airflow-related work, and treat any match as context rather than proof of cause.
